scenario: Duration comparison is signed integer comparison per LTIM.5.4. `(e.fired_at - f.fired_at) > 30_s` (Duration > Duration literal) compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule r:
    Event e where e.entity_id == "a"
    Event f where f.entity_id == "b" and (e.fired_at - f.fired_at) > 30_s
->
    log info "gap is large"
